links.outcome: Reproducibility of ChatGPT pharmacotherapy answers across repeated runs at three time points
links.effect: Percent agreement between weeks 1 and 3 was 79.2%, weeks 3 and 5 was 87.5%, and weeks 1 and 5 was 83.3%; hit rate 70.83% at week 1, 79.2% at week 3, 75% at week 5.
links.quote: The percent agreement between weeks 1 and 3 was 79.2%, whereas it was 87.5% between weeks 3 and 5, and 83.3% between weeks 1 and 5.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the accuracy and consistency of ChatGPT across 20 pharmacotherapy case vignettes compared to global clinical pharmacy experts without evaluating a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
